title: Decent but slow support
text: Chat support takes forever to respond, waited almost a day for a reply about a failed transaction.

title: KYC document rejected
text: Uploaded a clear photo of my PAN card, still got rejected for 'unclear document'. No idea what's wrong with it.

title: Clean charts
text: Really like the mutual fund comparison charts, makes it easy to pick between similar funds.

title: Withdrawal taking too long
text: Redemption initiated 6 days ago, bank account still not credited. Support just repeats the same SLA message.

title: SIP charged wrong amount
text: My SIP autodebit charged more than the set amount this month, no explanation from support yet.

title: Good fund discovery
text: Fund screener and filters are genuinely useful for comparing expense ratios and past returns.

title: Onboarding stuck at selfie step
text: Live selfie verification during signup failed repeatedly in low light, had to retry five times.

title: Statement export slow
text: Downloading the annual capital gains statement took multiple retries before the PDF finally generated.

title: UPI mandate failed silently
text: Autopay mandate failed with no notification, found out only when my SIP was marked missed a week later.

title: Great UI overall
text: Very intuitive app, dashboard gives a clear snapshot of my portfolio at a glance.

title: KYC pending for days
text: Filed KYC over a week ago, status still shows pending with no update or ETA given anywhere in the app.

title: Payment failed, money held
text: Bank confirmed the UPI debit went through but Groww still shows the payment as failed. Funds in limbo for 3 days.

title: KYC stuck for a week
text: My KYC has been 'under review' for 7 days now. No update, no email. Can't invest until this clears.

title: Re-KYC nightmare
text: Asked to redo KYC even though I completed it last year on another app. Aadhaar OTP failed three times before it worked.

title: Good app but onboarding is slow
text: Signup itself is easy but the KYC + bank linking took almost 3 days end to end. Once done, app is smooth.

title: Great for SIPs
text: Been using Groww for a year now, SIPs run like clockwork every month. Love the clean UI.

title: Withdrawal delay
text: Requested withdrawal 5 days ago, still shows processing. Support ticket got auto-closed without resolution.

title: Payment failed but money deducted
text: UPI payment failed on the app but amount was debited from my bank. Had to wait 2 days for auto-refund.

title: Statement download broken
text: Capital gains statement PDF fails to generate for FY, keeps showing 'try again later' for over a week.

title: Onboarding asked for documents twice
text: Uploaded PAN and address proof, got rejected with no reason, had to resubmit the exact same documents again.

title: Smooth withdrawals now
text: After a rough month, withdrawals are now credited within 24 hours. Much better experience recently.

title: KYC verification confusing
text: The KYC flow doesn't clearly say what went wrong. Just says 'verification pending' with no next steps.

title: Payment gateway timeout
text: Tried to add funds via UPI three times, gateway kept timing out. Ended up using a different app.

title: Statements are useful
text: Tax statements are well organized now, exported my capital gains report for filing without much trouble.

title: Withdrawal stuck in processing
text: My redemption request has been 'processing' for 4 days. Called support, they just said 'wait 24-48 hrs' again.

title: Onboarding could be faster
text: Account opening took 2 days for KYC approval. Not bad but competitors do it in hours.

title: Payment debited twice
text: Got charged twice for the same SIP installment this month. Refund for the duplicate charge still pending.

title: Best investing app
text: Simple interface, good fund recommendations, and customer support resolved my query within a day.

title: Statement mismatch
text: The holdings statement doesn't match what's shown on the dashboard. Numbers are off by a small amount, confusing.

title: KYC rejected without reason
text: Third time my KYC got rejected. No explanation given, just told to 'try again'. Very frustrating process.

title: Withdrawal improved
text: Redemption to bank account happened faster this time, credited in about a day and a half.

title: UPI autopay failing
text: SIP autopay via UPI mandate has failed twice this month even though there were sufficient funds.

title: Onboarding document upload issue
text: App kept crashing while uploading PAN card photo during signup. Had to restart the process from scratch.

title: Withdrawal delayed again
text: Second month in a row my withdrawal has taken more than 5 business days to reflect in my bank account.

title: Statements finally easy
text: Downloaded my full year capital gains statement in seconds, big improvement from a few months ago.

title: Payment stuck in pending
text: Added funds via net banking, transaction shows pending for over 24 hours with no confirmation either way.

title: KYC loop
text: Stuck in a loop where the app asks me to complete KYC, I complete it, and it asks again the next day.

title: Overall solid experience
text: Minor hiccups with statement generation but onboarding and day-to-day investing experience has been good.

title: Re-KYC every few months
text: Why do I need to redo KYC every 3-4 months? Already verified, feels like the same loop each time.

title: Onboarding fine, just slow
text: Nothing broken, but bank account linking step took an extra day to confirm compared to other apps.

title: Withdrawal ETA missing
text: No clear ETA shown for redemption anywhere in the app, just a generic 'processing' label that doesn't update.

title: Statement totals wrong
text: Capital gains total in the PDF doesn't match the in-app summary. Had to manually recalculate for tax filing.

title: Payments mostly smooth
text: UPI payments work fine most of the time, only had one failed transaction in the last two months.

title: KYC support unhelpful
text: Support just told me to 'wait for the team to review' with zero visibility into what's actually pending.

title: Withdrawal support unresponsive
text: Raised two tickets about a delayed withdrawal, both closed with a canned response and no real resolution.

title: Reliable for SIPs
text: Six months in, SIPs have never failed once. Very consistent experience for long-term investing.

title: Statements ok now
text: PDF generation is faster than before, though the layout could still be clearer for tax purposes.

title: Onboarding rejected twice
text: Address proof got rejected twice for being 'not clear' despite being a scanned government document.

title: Duplicate SIP debit
text: Charged twice for the same monthly SIP again this cycle. This is the second time this has happened.

title: Withdrawal within a day
text: Redemption credited within about 20 hours this time, noticeably better than a few months back.

title: KYC rejected, no reason
text: Verification failed with just a generic error code, no explanation of what document or field was wrong.

title: Payment gateway error
text: Tried adding funds via card, got a generic gateway error with no details. Had to switch to UPI instead.

title: Good statement clarity
text: Yearly summary statement is clean and easy to read now, filed my taxes with it directly.

title: Withdrawal slower than expected
text: Took about 3 days for the redemption to reflect, app said 'usually 24-48 hours' so a bit off from stated SLA.

title: KYC verification loop again
text: Same KYC loop issue as other users mention here, verified once, asked again a week later for no clear reason.

title: Autopay mandate confusion
text: UPI autopay mandate setup screen doesn't clearly explain what happens if the bank rejects the mandate.

title: Onboarding smoother now
text: Signup and KYC together took under a day this time, an improvement from my last attempt a few months ago.

title: Withdrawal delayed with no update
text: Redemption has been pending 4 days, no push notification or email update on status at all.

title: Payment refund slow
text: Refund for a failed UPI payment took 4 business days to land back in my account.

title: Great fund research tools
text: The research reports and fund comparison tools genuinely help with decision making before investing.

title: KYC document loop
text: Uploaded the same PAN card three times, rejected each time with the exact same vague error message.

title: Statement PDF slow to load
text: Takes a while to generate the capital gains PDF, sometimes times out and needs a retry.

title: Withdrawal support canned replies
text: Support chat gives the same templated 'please wait 24-48 hours' message regardless of how long it's already been.
